# Apostello Detailing

> Mobile car, boat, and interior detailing service run by Shiloh, operating by appointment 7 days a week. The team comes to the customer's home, workplace, or marina rather than requiring a shop visit.

## Business
- Name: Apostello Detailing
- Phone: (540) 484-3990
- Email: apostello.business@gmail.com
- Tagline: Clean. Protect. Restore.
- Service area: Franklin County, VA and surrounding areas, including Rocky Mount, VA and Smith Mountain Lake, VA

## Services
- Mobile car detailing (exterior and interior)
- Mobile auto detailing for cars, trucks, and SUVs
- Boat detailing, including pontoon boats, at Smith Mountain Lake
- RV detailing
- Recurring/membership detailing plans
- Referral program for existing customers
